entities.name: Svogthos
entities.description: Guildhall of the Golgari in the Undercity of Ravnica, a former Orzhov cathedral.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Guild that originally built the cathedral.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: Golgari parun entombed there, raised by Savra, later disintegrated leaving his skull.

entities.name: Jarad vod Savo
entities.description: Savra's brother who succeeded her as guildmaster.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Golgari guildmaster; moved the court back into Svogthos and was later compleated.

entities.name: Storrev
entities.description: Lich who let visitors into Svogthos.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Sought Golgari aid in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Invader the Golgari helped defend against.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Cracked the cathedral walls on Vraska's command.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Invasion of Ravnica by Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Savra raises Svogthir; after he tries to betray her he is disintegrated and she takes over as guildmaster.
events.quote: Savra then took over as guildmaster

events.summary: After Savra's death the role passes to Jarad.
events.quote: passing to her brother, Jarad vod Savo

events.summary: After Jarad's death, Vraska moves the Golgari court back into Svogthos.
events.quote: Vraska moved the Golgari court back into Svogthos

events.summary: Ral, Kaya, Teyo and Araithia are brought into Svogthos by Storrev seeking aid against the Dreadhorde.
events.quote: were allowed through Korozda and brought into Svogthos by the lich Storrev

events.summary: Vraska returns and agrees to have the Golgari join the defense against Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: Vraska agreed to have the Golgari join the defense of the plane against Nicol Bolas

events.summary: Realmbreaker cracks the cathedral walls on the compleated Vraska's command.
events.quote: Realmbreaker cracked the cathedral walls of Svogthos on command of the compleated Vraska.

relations.quote: Svogthos is the Guildhall of the Golgari in the Undercity of Ravnica .
